run.notes: First measurement ever taken on this rig. Harness ported into the rig for this run; the eleven inherited copies elsewhere in the tree post to /v1/completions, which is empty on -it checkpoints.

pricing.source: aws ec2 describe-spot-price-history, g4dn.xlarge Linux/UNIX us-east-1c, 2026-08-30T19:00Z

model.architecture_notes: Heterogeneous head_dim: 28 sliding_attention layers at 256, 7 full_attention at 512. That heterogeneity is why vLLM forces TRITON_ATTN (FA4 unavailable), and the 512-wide global prefill tile is what overruns Turing's 64 KiB shared-memory limit. Checkpoint ships bf16; Turing has no bf16 datapath, so vLLM converts to float16 once at load.

software.backend: cuda; TRITON_ATTN (vLLM forces it for Gemma 4's heterogeneous head_dim)

notes: COMPARISON IS NOT CONTROLLED. The g5g baseline (2026-08-14-rust-frontend-g5g, Py-1) ran vLLM 0.27.2rc1.dev0 built from source on g5g.4xlarge (16 vCPU, on-demand) under `vllm bench serve` with --dataset-name random. This ran vLLM 0.28.0 from the published amd64 image on g4dn.xlarge (4 vCPU, spot) under this rig's own harness with English filler sized via /tokenize. Engine version, harness, host size and prompt content all differ. The GPUs do not: both SM 7.5, both 15360 MiB, both 5001 MHz memory clock, and both report GPU KV cache of exactly 329,579 tokens.

Because decode is GPU-bandwidth-bound and the two GPUs are spec-identical, a 42-48% throughput gap CANNOT be attributed to the host CPU -- the CPU is not the bottleneck at these rates. Engine version is the leading candidate. Do not report this as an Intel-vs-Arm result without a matched-version run.

startup.notes: cloud-init INSTALL_COMPLETE at +195s (pull 155s, patch 176s, build 178s, verified-in-image 193s); engine init 150.90s of which 82.39s compilation; weights download 30.03s; checkpoint load 23.33s.

memory.notes: nvidia-smi reports 15360 MiB. Model loading took 9.8 GiB. GPU KV cache 329,579 tokens; max concurrency 20.12x at 16,384 tokens/request -- identical to the g5g baseline's 329,579, confirming matched engine config.

cost.notes: Spot $0.3559/hr, g4dn.xlarge us-east-1c, verified via describe-spot-price-history at the time of the run. At on-demand $0.526/hr the saturation figure is $0.6026/M. Compute only -- excludes EBS and data transfer.
